description: The full 169-hand-type range (fold/call/raise per hand type: AA, AKs, AKo, ...) for a position + action line. No hole_cards. Charges 1 presolved quota (one call, not 169).

hero.description: the position whose range you want: UTG / MP / CO / BTN / SB / BB

preflop_actions.description: action sequence incl. blinds; the range is for `hero` acting after these actions

amount.description: bet-to amount in big blinds (0.5 SB, 1 BB, 3 for a 3bb open)

position.description: SB / BB / UTG / MP / CO / BTN

preflop_version.description: chart-set id from preflop_versions; omit for the default

name: preflop_range
title: Whole preflop range for a spot
